validations.name: Applicant fails an eligibility requirement
validations.statement: When a configured eligibility requirement disqualifies the applicant, show the shared ineligibility alert on submission. The eligibility rules retain their own facts, values and thresholds; this defines their common message only. Missing or malformed field values use normal field validation.

validations.name: State must be eligible
validations.statement: When eligible-states-only is enabled, validate the selected State / Province against the effective eligible options. ZIP/postal inference is optional; an unresolved code does not reject a valid manual selection.

validations.name: At least one child when Child is selected
validations.statement: When Child is selected as a dependent, at least one child must be added.

validations.name: Spouse details when Spouse is selected
validations.statement: When Spouse is selected as a dependent, the spouse's details must be entered.
